VO2 Max Estimator

Estimate your VO2 max cardio fitness score from a 12-minute Cooper run or from resting heart rate.

–
VO2 max (ml/kg/min)
–

Estimates only, not a lab measurement. The Cooper test needs a true maximal 12-minute effort.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick the Cooper 12-minute run or the resting heart rate method.
  2. Enter your distance covered or your age and resting heart rate.
  3. Read your estimated VO2 max and fitness rating.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the Cooper test formula?

VO2 max = (distance in meters − 504.9) ÷ 44.73, from Kenneth Cooper's original 1968 research on the 12-minute run.

How does the heart rate method work?

It uses the ratio of max heart rate (estimated as 208 − 0.7 × age) to resting heart rate: VO2 max ≈ 15 × (HRmax ÷ HRrest).

What is a good VO2 max?

For men 30-39, above ~45 is good and above ~52 excellent; for women 30-39, above ~38 is good and above ~45 excellent. Ratings shift with age.
